summary: Plan revision 10 and all five registered design documents are coherent for this bounded synthetic, read-only increment. Every registered document SHA-256 and the plan/contract hashes match; the harness binding remained unchanged at review completion. The regression matrix concretizes existing contracts and does not require normative document amendments: initial-read disconnect enforces the existing cancellation/generation rule; independent heartbeat/read tracking, serialized renewal/read operations and retained cadence implement the existing connected-state and recovery guards; strict whitespace handling enforces JSON syntax; originless-read, restart, WebSocket, metadata and expiry cases strengthen evidence for existing boundaries. The plan explicitly preserves parent security controls while leaving BB-01..10 and runtime effect-counter verification incomplete.

assessment: Endpoint schemas, validation precedence, response-only CORS decoration, exact admission rules and credential lifecycle are sufficiently specified for the bounded implementation.

Pair rejection, uncertain pair outcome, read failure, heartbeat failure, terminal capability authentication and unconfirmed revoke remain distinct. Malformed pair success requires a fresh code; revoke 401 never becomes confirmed server revocation.

Successful reads must obey the connected-state guard and cannot erase an independent heartbeat failure. Heartbeat recovery requires renewal plus validated fresh snapshot/events; renewal alone cannot erase a read error.
Immediate disconnect after capability acceptance is compatible with authenticated-loading and mandatory cancellation of requests, timers and stale responses.
Synthetic-state equality and absent-call-site review are explicitly partial evidence, not substitutes for parent runtime handler/effect counters.

evidence_limits: Read-only document and hash review; no files were edited and no report was written.
No tests, builds, services, browser sessions or runtime probes were executed.
This verdict does not approve implementation source, verify regression closure or satisfy running-application design QA.
No parent BB-01..10 completion, production readiness, SDK safety or OS-isolation guarantee is established.
